suggested_requirements.text: The system shall allow the user to split a PDF document into multiple parts based on selected options.
The system shall allow the user to merge multiple PDF documents or subsections thereof.
The system shall allow the user to extract sections of a PDF document into a single document.
The system shall allow the user to mix pages from two PDF documents alternatively.
The system shall allow the user to rotate pages of selected PDF documents.
The system shall allow the user to visually reorder pages of a PDF document.
The system shall allow the user to visually compose a new document by dragging pages from selected PDF documents.
The system shall allow the user to save and load the current working environment.
The system shall display log messages for operations in a log panel.
The system shall allow the user to manage application settings.
The system shall provide a command-line interface for all features.
The system shall allow the user to split only one document at a time.
The system shall require PDF version 1.5 or above for output file compression.
The system shall limit the number of digits for the unique [FILENUMBER] prefix to 10 or less.
The system shall allow the user to mix only two documents at a time.
The system shall allow the user to manipulate only one document at a time in the visual reorder plugin.
The system shall require the log level to be set to a value other than OFF for the log panel to function.
The system shall require an application restart for settings changes to be applied.
The system shall be designed to not delay the system from other key processes.
The system response time shall be direct and considered real-time.
The system shall provide a user-friendly graphical interface.
The system shall be platform independent and require a Java Virtual Machine version 1.6 or higher.
The system shall be released under the GNU General Public License.
